text.p: U.S. financial markets will be closed on Friday July 4 for the U.S. Independence Day holiday.
U.S. bond and foreign exchange markets will close at 1500 EDT/1900 GMT on Thursday July 3 and will reopen on Monday July 7.
The New York Stock Exchange, American Stock Exchange and Nasdaq will close at 1300 EDT/1700 GMT on July 3 and reopen on July 7.

On the Commodity Exchanges, Nymex Palladium futures and Copper futures and options will close at 1300EDT/1700GMT July 3. Silver futures and options will close at 1305EDT/1705GMT. Gold and platinum futures and options will close at 1310EDT/1710GMT.

ON the Nymex, Palo Verdeand electricity futures and options will close at 1255 EDT/1655GMT July 3. Crude oil, heating oil, gasoline, natural gas futures and Cobb electricity futures and options will close at 1300EDT (1700GMT).
All commodities exchanges will be closed July 4 and will reopen July 7.
Chicago Board of Trade, Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) and Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) will be closed July 4.
CBOT financial and insurance contracts will close at 1210 CDT/1710 GMT on July 3 but all agricultural and metals contracts will observe normal schedules.
Project A and the CBOT evening pit sessions will be closed July 3.
On Sunday, July 6, the CBOT evening pit session and overnight Project A trading will be open.

On July 3, CME interest-rate and currency products will close at 1200 CDT/1700 GMT, equity and GSCI products will close at 1215 CDT/1715 GMT, and agricultural contracts will close at 1300 CDT/1800 GMT.
A GLOBEX session starts at 1430 CDT/1930 GMT on July 3 and ends at 1030 CDT/1530 GMT July 4. GLOBEX will open at 1730 CDT/2230 GMT on July 6 and will close at its regularly scheduled time on July 7.

CBOE interest rate options close at 1200 CDT/1700 GMT on July 3, equity options and sector index options will close at 1202 CDT/1702 GMT, and broad-based index options and international index options will close at 1215 CDT/1715 GMT.
